name: California State Summer School for the Arts (CSSSA)
org: California State Summer School for the Arts (state program)
city: California (the 2027 campus is not named yet)
what_you_do: This is a month long, pre-professional summer arts program. Students train in one department. Choices are animation, dance, film and music. Others are theater, visual art, writing, or architecture and environment.
who_can_apply: California residents in grades 8 to 12. Up to 20 students from out of state and other countries may also be enrolled. Each department has its own assignments.
pay_detail: The Tuition and Fees page lists $5,433 for California residents and $10,999 for out of state and international students, with no year printed and May 2027 payment dates. The FAQ still shows $5,174 for 2026 and says 2027 rates 'will be posted soon'. Need based aid is available to California residents (nearly half of past students had much of tuition covered). $20 application fee, with fee waivers for students with financial need.
duration: About one month: first day of classes July 5 and graduation July 31, 2027
deadline_text: The site says 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026, and its How to Apply page still says the application will open in November. Application and scholarship priority deadline is Feb 28, 2027, 6 pm, with no extensions. Session: registration July 3, classes July 5, graduation July 31, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online by department. A full application has the form and two teacher references, not peers. It has an unofficial transcript and department assignments. It has the $20 fee. It has the financial aid request if you want aid. Students can apply to more than one department. Each needs a full application.
notes: Students who finish can get 3 units of college extension credit from the California State University system (per the FAQ). Not a job. The pages did not name the 2027 campus, so check before planning travel. Status is unconfirmed because on 2026-11-02 the pages had not changed to say the application is live, and Apply Now leads only to a general log in and create account page that names no year. Check the Apply Now link on the site.
